title: Personal Checking: Linked Savings Funds and Overdraft Fees on Debits Paid Into Overdraft
content:
## Principle

A Personal Checking debit that an overdraft protection transfer pays is not an overdraft. The per-debit overdraft fee on a debit that such a transfer would have paid was therefore charged in error.

## How the question is judged in a refund decision

Neither the savings balance at the moment the debit posted nor the shortfall the debit left is kept on the checking record. When the refund of a per-debit overdraft fee is decided, the question is therefore answered from what can be read at the time of the decision:

- **Which savings account** — whichever one is linked to the checking account for overdraft protection at the time of deciding.
- **Its tier** — whether the Savings & Money Market Accounts terms make that savings tier eligible as an overdraft protection source.
- **Its balance** — the money that savings account holds when the decision is made, compared with the whole amount of the debit that drew the fee (not merely the shortfall).

The fee is a bank error on this ground when the linked savings tier is eligible **and** its current balance is at least the whole debit amount, because a transfer would then have paid the debit. An account with no linked savings account when the decision is made gives no finding on this ground.

This test belongs to the refund decision only. It does not change how actual overdraft protection transfers are made, which still require the savings balance to meet the whole shortfall at the moment of the debit.

## Truth table

| Link in place at decision time | Linked tier eligible | Current savings balance at least the debit amount | Bank error on this ground |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | yes |
| yes | yes | no | no |
| yes | no | yes | no |
| yes | no | no | no |
| no | — | — | no |

## Hypothetical cases

- Debit 212.40 USD; linked savings in an eligible tier now holds 500.00 USD: bank error.
- Debit 212.40 USD; linked savings in an eligible tier now holds 212.40 USD: equal amounts suffice, bank error.
- Debit 212.40 USD; linked savings in an eligible tier now holds 150.00 USD: no error on this ground, even though 150.00 USD might have exceeded the shortfall.
